text: Every step, actor and slot value MUST quote the goal text (or a project file the user named, with its path and line); NEVER state a business rule, message, limit, role or step the source does not state.
checklist: Every quote is found word for word in the goal or the cited file; no fact appears without a quote.

text: Everything the source does not state MUST become an open business question with an id and the steps it affects; NEVER fill a gap with a usual default.
checklist: Every gap points to a question id that exists and names its steps.

text: Every step MUST list all seven slots in order: Loading, Empty, Error, Success, Validation, Reload and back, Permissions; each slot is a quote, a question id, or Not applicable with a reason.
checklist: Each step has the seven slot lines in order.

text: A question MUST ask, never suggest: no answer options, no examples, no for example, no named product or provider the goal does not name.
checklist: No question has options, examples, for example, e.g., such as, or a provider the goal does not name.

text: A question that stops the journey from being finished MUST be marked [blocking]; the others MUST be [minor], merged by topic into one line each.
checklist: Every question is tagged; blocking first; minor merged one line per topic.

text: The skill MUST be read-only: NEVER write, edit or delete a file and NEVER run a command; the map is the reply.
checklist: The transcript has no write, edit, delete or shell tool call.

text: A request with no feature goal MUST get only the fixed question of layer 03, step 3.
checklist: A request without a goal got exactly the fixed question.

text: A request for acceptance criteria MUST start with the fixed sentence of layer 06, step 3, and the reply MUST contain no Given-When-Then clause.
checklist: An acceptance-criteria request starts with the fixed sentence and has no Given-When-Then clause.

text: A request for a regression checklist or what to retest after a change or a diff MUST get only the fixed sentence of layer 06, step 4.
checklist: A retest request got exactly the fixed sentence.

text: The reply MUST follow the format of layer 08: header, Steps, Cross-step checks, Open business questions, Not in this map.
checklist: The reply has every section of layer 08 in order.

text: Two statements of the goal that disagree MUST become one blocking question starting Conflict: that quotes both; NEVER choose one.
checklist: A conflict is one blocking Conflict: question quoting both statements.

text: The skill MUST have the ten core layers, each linked from SKILL.md, and stay self-contained with no repository paths.
SKILL.md MUST stay within 150 lines, with frontmatter name, description and semver version.
checklist: SKILL.md is at most 150 lines with valid frontmatter.
